Load hoopR NBA Stats game matchups

Source: R/load_nba_stats_extra.R
load_nba_stats_game_matchups.Rd

Loads the nba_stats_game_matchups release: the boxscorematchupsv3 matchups of every game of a season, one row per (offensive player, defensive player) pair per game, with matchup time, partial possessions, switches and the points, assists, turnovers, blocks and shooting the defender allowed. Season-long matchup totals are in load_nba_stats_matchups().

Usage

load_nba_stats_game_matchups(
  seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

The nba_stats_game_matchups release: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/nba_stats_game_matchups, published by https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data.

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit years – the season's START year (e.g. 2024 for the 2024-25 season). Published coverage starts at 2017 (2017-18). Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season.

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the data table within the database

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per matchup pair per game.

col_nametypesdescription
off_team_idintegerTeam id of the offensive player. Taken from the payload's team block.
off_team_citycharacterCity/market of the offensive player's team ("Indiana").
off_team_namecharacterNickname of the offensive player's team ("Pacers") – pair with off_team_city for the full club name.
off_team_tricodecharacterThree-letter abbreviation of the offensive player's team ("IND").
off_team_slugcharacterURL slug of the offensive player's team ("pacers").
def_team_idintegerTeam id of the defender, read from the game envelope's homeTeamId/awayTeamId rather than the nested team object, which is 0 on uncovered captures.
sidecharacterWhich side of the game the row's team was on: "home" or "away". In game_matchups, where a row carries two teams, it is the OFFENSIVE player's team (off_team_id) – the defender is always the other side.
off_person_idintegerstats.nba.com person id of the offensive player – the one being guarded.
off_first_namecharacterFirst name of the offensive player.
off_family_namecharacterFamily name of the offensive player.
off_name_icharacterOffensive player's abbreviated display name ("B. Mathurin").
off_player_slugcharacterURL slug of the offensive player ("bennedict-mathurin").
off_positioncharacterStarting position of the offensive player as the payload reports it; empty for players who did not start.
off_commentcharacterAvailability note on the offensive player (DNP reason); empty when they played.
off_jersey_numcharacterJersey number of the offensive player, as a string (it can carry a leading zero, e.g. "00").
def_person_idintegerstats.nba.com person id of the defender guarding the offensive player.
def_first_namecharacterFirst name of the defender.
def_family_namecharacterFamily name of the defender.
def_name_icharacterDefender's abbreviated display name ("J. Allen").
def_player_slugcharacterURL slug of the defender ("jarrett-allen").
def_jersey_numcharacterJersey number of the defender, as a string (it can carry a leading zero).
matchup_minutescharacterTime the pair were matched up, as the payload's MM:SS string; use matchup_minutes_sort for arithmetic.
matchup_minutes_sortnumericThe same matchup time in seconds, as a float – the sortable/summable form.
partial_possessionsnumericPossessions credited to the matchup. Fractional because a possession is split across every defender who guarded the ball-handler during it, which is why matchup counting stats do not sum exactly to a player's game totals.
percentage_defender_total_timenumericShare of the defender's floor time spent guarding this offensive player.
percentage_offensive_total_timenumericShare of the offensive player's floor time spent guarded by this defender.
percentage_total_time_both_onnumericShare of the time both players were on the floor together that they were matched up.
switches_onintegerTimes the defense switched this defender onto the offensive player.
player_pointsintegerPoints the offensive player scored while guarded by this defender.
team_pointsintegerPoints the offensive player's team scored while this matchup was on.
matchup_assistsintegerAssists by the offensive player while guarded by this defender.
matchup_potential_assistsintegerPasses by the offensive player that would have been assists had the shot fallen, while guarded by this defender.
matchup_turnoversintegerTurnovers by the offensive player while guarded by this defender.
matchup_blocksintegerShots by the offensive player blocked by this defender.
matchup_field_goals_madeintegerField goals made by the offensive player against this defender.
matchup_field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted by the offensive player against this defender.
matchup_field_goals_percentagenumericField-goal percentage of the offensive player against this defender.
matchup_three_pointers_madeintegerThree-pointers made by the offensive player against this defender.
matchup_three_pointers_attemptedintegerThree-pointers attempted by the offensive player against this defender.
matchup_three_pointers_percentagenumericThree-point percentage of the offensive player against this defender.
help_blocksintegerBlocks by this defender on the offensive player when helping off another assignment rather than as the primary defender.
help_field_goals_madeintegerField goals the offensive player made against this defender in help defense.
help_field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals the offensive player attempted against this defender in help defense.
help_field_goals_percentagenumericField-goal percentage allowed by this defender in help defense.
matchup_free_throws_madeintegerFree throws made by the offensive player on trips drawn against this defender.
matchup_free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted by the offensive player on trips drawn against this defender.
shooting_foulsintegerShooting fouls committed by this defender on the offensive player.
game_idcharacter10-digit zero-padded stats.nba.com game id (e.g. '0022500001').
seasonintegerEND year of the NBA season (2025 = 2024-25), the asset's own stamp: one more than the seasons argument.
season_type_idcharacterSeason-type digit: the 3rd character of game_id (and the leading digit of season_id). 1 = preseason, 2 = regular season, 3 = All-Star, 4 = playoffs, 5 = play-in, 6 = NBA Cup final, 9 = international.

See also

The publishing pipeline, https://github.com/sportsdataverse/hoopR-nba-stats-data, and the Python twin sportsdataverse.nba.load_nba_stats_game_matchups().

Other NBA Stats loader functions: load_nba_stats_coaches(), load_nba_stats_draft_combine, load_nba_stats_hustle, load_nba_stats_injury_report(), load_nba_stats_leaguedash(), load_nba_stats_matchups(), load_nba_stats_metric_curves(), load_nba_stats_rolling_windows(), load_nba_stats_synergy()

Examples

# \donttest{
  # Interactive only: a 5.6 MB file of about 260,000 rows per season.
  try(load_nba_stats_game_matchups(seasons = most_recent_nba_stats_season()))
